intro: On {path}, the code and key are entered manually or read from {link}. After the anti-bot check, the API returns 1 (valid), 0 (forged), 2 (expired), 3 (revoked) or another code in the <catalog>catalog</catalog>.
localHint: When disabled, the page uses the local registry at {path}, including its demo codes.
responseHint: Paths in the JSON response: code reads a root field, data.result.code a nested field. A verification code is required to interpret the response.
demoHint: Shows examples below the form at {path}. Turn this off in production to hide the local registry examples.
loadError: Could not read verification settings. Showing defaults.
requestHint: GET sends the code and key in the query string. POST sends the same fields in a JSON body.
fallback: Use the local registry if the API is unavailable
fallbackHint: If the API cannot be reached, the page uses the local registry and tells the visitor. When disabled, an API outage displays an error so that third parties do not rely on an unverified document.
demo: Show demo codes on the public page
test_NON_CONFIGUREE: Enter an API URL starting with http:// or https://.
test_PARAMETRES: Supply a verification key for the test.
test_REPONSE_API: Could not read the API response. Check the response field settings.
unmapped: Code “{code}” is not in the catalog; the public page would refuse to display it.
